title: ATEP mandate
description: Section 7.2. A signed, per-transaction authorization for a binding action. It covers exactly one action with exactly those terms.

for.description: Section 7.2. cancel, reschedule, or quote, or the name of an extension intent that declares that it requires a mandate.

expires.description: Section 7.2. At most one hour after issued.

credential.description: Section 7.2. Issued after the terms were shown to the principal.

x-atep-max-lifetime.description: Section 7.2. A mandate expires in at most one hour.

terms.description: Section 7.2. The exact terms the answerer stated in mandate_required.
